# Overview

**Module 7: Repeat lengths**

Every repeat-length distribution in one place:

1. **Cohort heatmaps** – every sample's distribution side by side, one per measure, grouped by settings group and ordered by time
2. **Distributions by group** – for each group, a density (ridge) figure, with every read as a dot, and a histogram figure, with its samples stacked in time order: for all lengths and for each range drawn
3. **Sample cards** – one figure per sample: for every measure, reads and (with UMIs) molecules in separate rows on their own scales, for all lengths and each range drawn, with each row's modal, median and mean marked

Reads are grey and molecules (UMI-collapsed) teal throughout, and every figure and file name says which it shows.

**Outputs:**

- Every file is named `{plot type}_{sample or group}_{measure}_{all-lengths or range}_{unit}.png`, and saved in a folder named after the plot type, split into a subfolder per unit and, for the group and per-sample range figures, per range (e.g. `sample_density/combined/range02/`); the unit is `combined` (reads and molecules in one figure), `reads` or `molecules`, as chosen by `plot_units` (`r paste(plot_units_for(params, isTRUE(params$umi)), collapse = ", ")` in this run). Which plot types are made is set by `plots`.
- `07_repeat_lengths/plots/heatmap/` – every sample's distribution, one per measure and unit
- `07_repeat_lengths/plots/group_density/`, `group_histogram/` – each group's samples, for all lengths and `r if (isTRUE(params$plot_every_range)) "every range of the primary measure" else "plot_ranges (plot_every_range = FALSE)"`
- `07_repeat_lengths/plots/sample_ranges/` – each sample in every range
- `07_repeat_lengths/plots/sample_card/` – each sample's every measure, for all lengths and the ranges drawn in the report
- `07_repeat_lengths/plots/sample_density/`, `sample_histogram/` – each sample, one file per range (only when selected in `plots`)
- `07_repeat_lengths/repeat_lengths.xlsx` – the sample order and labels used

```{r load}
safe_load_module(file.path(params$dir_out, "module_data", "03_repeat_detection.RData"), 3)
measures <- module3_output$measures; primary <- module3_output$primary
lengths <- module3_output$lengths
rm(module3_output); invisible(gc())
mol <- NULL
m4 <- file.path(params$dir_out, "module_data", "04_umi.RData")
if (isTRUE(params$umi) && file.exists(m4)) { safe_load_module(m4, 4); mol <- module4_output$molecule_lengths; rm(module4_output) }
m6 <- file.path(params$dir_out, "module_data", "06_instability.RData")
have_m6 <- file.exists(m6)
if (have_m6) { safe_load_module(m6, 6); settings <- module6_output$settings; range_table <- as.data.table(module6_output$range_table)
               dist <- module6_output$distribution_summary } else { settings <- NULL; range_table <- NULL; dist <- NULL }
samples <- unique(lengths$file_stem)
# Samples marked exclude in the settings file are left out here too, as in Module 6
if (have_m6 && !is.null(module6_output$excluded) && NROW(module6_output$excluded) && "file_stem" %in% names(module6_output$excluded))
  samples <- setdiff(samples, module6_output$excluded$file_stem)
lengths <- lengths[file_stem %in% samples]
if (!is.null(mol)) mol <- mol[file_stem %in% samples]
meta <- data.table(file_stem = samples)
if (!is.null(settings)) meta <- as.data.table(settings)[, .(file_stem, group, time)][meta, on = "file_stem"] else meta[, `:=`(group = NA_character_, time = NA_real_)]
meta[, group_label := ifelse(is.na(group), "ungrouped", group)]
setorder(meta, group_label, time, file_stem, na.last = TRUE)
meta[, sample_label := make.unique(ifelse(is.na(time), file_stem, paste0(file_stem, " (t=", time, ")")))]
meta[, sample_label := factor(sample_label, levels = sample_label)]
meta[, sample_index := seq_len(.N)]
# Sample labels: the part of the file name that differs between samples (e.g. kxF01--kxR13) when
# that is short, otherwise the sample's index in this report (mapped to its file in repeat_lengths.xlsx)
sl <- short_labels(meta$file_stem)[meta$file_stem]
base_lab <- if (max(nchar(sl)) <= 20) sl else as.character(meta$sample_index)
meta[, short_label := make.unique(ifelse(is.na(time), base_lab, paste0(base_lab, " (t=", time, ")")))]
meta[, short_label := factor(short_label, levels = short_label)]
plot_ranges <- if (length(params$plot_ranges)) params$plot_ranges else if (have_m6) head(sort(unique(range_table$range_name[range_table$measure == primary])), 2) else character(0)
group_ranges <- if (have_m6 && isTRUE(params$plot_every_range)) sort(unique(range_table$range_name[range_table$measure == primary])) else plot_ranges
acc_path <- file.path(params$dir_out, "02_alignment", "alignment.xlsx")
funnel <- if (file.exists(acc_path)) as.data.table(readxl::read_excel(acc_path, "read_accounting")) else NULL
stat_key <- "Dashed lines in each range: red = modal, purple = median, orange = mean length (Module 6), with their values in the panel header"
# Each sample's reads and molecules, split once (scanning the whole run for every figure was the slow part)
rl_s <- split(lengths, by = "file_stem", keep.by = FALSE)
ml_s <- if (!is.null(mol)) split(mol, by = "file_stem", keep.by = FALSE) else list()
rt_s <- if (have_m6) split(range_table, by = "file_stem") else list()
# Lengths of measure m for one sample, in one range (NULL = all lengths). The range is applied to its
# range_measure (the primary tract unless the measure has its own ranges), as in Module 6.
range_vals <- function(tab, idcol, m, rr = NULL) {
  if (is.null(tab) || !nrow(tab)) return(numeric(0))
  if (is.null(rr)) return(tab[measure == m, length])
  ids <- tab[measure == rr$range_measure & length >= rr$lo & length <= rr$hi][[idcol]]
  tab[measure == m & get(idcol) %in% ids, length]
}
range_row <- function(s, m, rg) { r <- rt_s[[s]]; if (is.null(r)) return(NULL); r <- r[measure == m & range_name == rg]; if (nrow(r)) r[1] else NULL }
# Versions of each figure (plot_units): combined (reads and molecules in one figure), reads, molecules.
# The version is the last part of every file name.
have_mol <- !is.null(mol)
pu <- plot_units_for(params, have_mol)
unit_title <- c(combined = "reads and molecules", reads = "reads", molecules = "molecules (UMI-collapsed)")
# The reads (rd) and molecules (md) of one version, and which one is drawn as the main unit
unit_version <- function(rd, md, u) switch(u, combined = list(rd = rd, md = md, main = "Reads"), reads = list(rd = rd, md = NULL, main = "Reads"),
                                           molecules = list(rd = md, md = NULL, main = "Molecules"))
```

`r if (!have_m6) "Module 6 has not been run (no settings file), so samples are not grouped and no ranges are drawn." else ""`

# Cohort heatmaps

Each column is one sample and each row one repeat length; the colour is the share of that sample's reads (or molecules) at that length, on a log scale from 0.01%, so a minor allele and a thin expansion tail are as visible as the main peak; white means no reads. The rarest 0.1% of lengths at the top are not drawn, so the alleles fill the plot. Panels are settings groups, and samples within a group are in time order, labelled by the part of the file name that differs between samples (or by an index, mapped to files in `repeat_lengths.xlsx`) and time. A stable sample is a narrow band; somatic expansion shows as the band spreading upward over time.

```{r heatmaps, results='asis', fig.height=7}
.t <- proc.time()["elapsed"]
hm_w <- min(45, max(9, 3 + 0.15 * length(samples)))
for (u in plot_units_for(params, have_mol, can_combine = FALSE)) for (m in measures$measure) {
  src <- if (u == "reads") lengths[measure == m, .(file_stem, length)] else mol[measure == m, .(file_stem, length)]
  if (!nrow(src)) next
  d <- meta[, .(file_stem, sample_label = short_label, group_label)][src, on = "file_stem"]
  p <- length_heatmap(d, sprintf("%s length, %s", m, u), params$repeat_histogram_binwidth, paste(m, "length"), u)
  save_plot(p, plot_path(plots_dir, "heatmap", m, unit = u), hm_w, 7)
  if (u == "reads" || m == primary) { cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s, %s\n\n", m, u)); print(p) }
}
timings["Heatmaps"] <- proc.time()["elapsed"] - .t
```

# Distributions by group

For each group, its samples stacked in time order, for the `r primary` length: all lengths, then the reads in each range saved (`r if (length(group_ranges)) paste(group_ranges, collapse = ", ") else "none"`), selected as in Module 6. Two figures are made for each group and each of these:

- **Density (ridge).** Each sample's reads as a grey density, scaled to the sample's own height, so its shape is visible whatever its depth`r if (!is.null(mol)) ", with the molecules as a teal line on the same row" else ""`. Along the bottom of each ridge, every `r dw <- if (!is.null(mol) && !identical(params$plot_dots_unit, "reads")) "molecule" else "read"; dw` is a dot (up to `r format(params$plot_dots_max, big.mark = ",")` per sample, drawn at random, spread slightly sideways) in a band of the same height at every length, so the dots are dense under a peak and sparse along a PCR smear or a thin expansion tail, where the density line is too flat to show how many there are`r if (!is.null(mol)) sprintf(" (in the figures with reads and molecules together the dots are the %ss, set by plot_dots_unit; the reads-only and molecules-only figures use their own unit)", dw) else ""`. Each dot is coloured by how many of the sample's `r dw`s have its length, as a share of the sample's commonest length on a log scale (dark purple = rare, yellow-green = the commonest), so the mode and the steps between whole units show where the dots would otherwise merge into a block; the red dashed line is the reads' modal length`r if (!is.null(mol)) " and the teal dashed line the molecules'" else ""`. In the all-lengths figure the largest allele sets the height, so look at the range figures for the shape of a smaller one.
- **Histogram.** One row per sample, with reads`r if (!is.null(mol)) " and molecules in separate columns" else ""`, each panel the share of that sample's reads`r if (!is.null(mol)) " (or molecules)" else ""` at each length on its own scale.

The first group's figures are shown here (the density and histogram for all lengths, and the density for each range in `plot_ranges`: `r paste(plot_ranges, collapse = ", ")`); every group is in `plots/group_density/{unit}/{all-lengths or range}/` and `plots/group_histogram/…`, named `group_density_{group}_{measure}_{all-lengths or range}_{unit}.png`, where the unit is `combined`, `reads` or `molecules` (`plot_units`).

```{r by_group, results='asis', fig.height=5}
.t <- proc.time()["elapsed"]
folders <- c(`all-lengths` = NA_character_, setNames(group_ranges, group_ranges))
# Each sample's reads (and molecules) of the primary measure for one folder, labelled
folder_data <- function(fs, rg) {
  rd <- rbindlist(lapply(fs, function(s) {
    rr <- if (is.na(rg)) NULL else range_row(s, primary, rg)
    if (!is.na(rg) && is.null(rr)) return(NULL)
    data.table(file_stem = s, length = range_vals(rl_s[[s]], "qname", primary, rr))
  }))
  md <- if (length(ml_s)) rbindlist(lapply(fs, function(s) {
    rr <- if (is.na(rg)) NULL else range_row(s, primary, rg)
    if (!is.na(rg) && is.null(rr)) return(NULL)
    data.table(file_stem = s, length = range_vals(ml_s[[s]], "molecule_id", primary, rr))
  })) else NULL
  lab <- meta[file_stem %in% fs, .(file_stem, label = droplevels(short_label))]
  # a sample with nothing in the range gives one NA row (data.table recycles the sample name); drop it
  rd <- rd[is.finite(length)]; if (!is.null(md)) md <- md[is.finite(length)]
  list(rd = lab[rd, on = "file_stem"], md = if (!is.null(md) && nrow(md)) lab[md, on = "file_stem"] else NULL)
}
folder_xlim <- function(x) c(min(x), stats::quantile(x, 0.999)) + c(-2, 2)
jobs <- CJ(folder = names(folders), group = unique(meta$group_label), sorted = FALSE)
done <- apply_fn(seq_len(nrow(jobs)), function(i) {
  f <- jobs$folder[i]; g <- jobs$group[i]; rg <- folders[[f]]
  fd <- folder_data(meta[group_label == g, file_stem], rg)
  if (!nrow(fd$rd)) return(NULL)
  n <- uniqueN(fd$rd$file_stem); xl <- folder_xlim(fd$rd$length)
  for (u in pu) {
    v <- unit_version(fd$rd, fd$md, u)
    if (is.null(v$rd) || !nrow(v$rd)) next
    ttl <- sprintf("%s: %s%s, %s", display_group(g), primary, if (is.na(rg)) ", all lengths" else paste0(", ", rg, " (", range_row(fd$rd$file_stem[1], primary, rg)$range_text, ")"), unit_title[[u]])
    if (want_plot("group_density", params))
      save_plot(ridge_dots_plot(v$rd, v$md, ttl, paste(primary, "length (repeat units)"), xl, params$plot_dots_max, main_unit = v$main, dots_unit = if (identical(params$plot_dots_unit, "reads")) "Reads" else "Molecules"),
                plot_path(plots_dir, "group_density", g, primary, f, unit = u), 11, min(45, 1.8 + 0.5 * n))
    if (want_plot("group_histogram", params))
      save_plot(hist_rows_plot(v$rd, v$md, ttl, paste(primary, "length (repeat units)"), xl, params$repeat_histogram_binwidth, main_unit = v$main),
                plot_path(plots_dir, "group_histogram", g, primary, f, unit = u), if (is.null(v$md)) 9 else 13, min(45, 1.4 + 0.7 * n))
  }
  TRUE
})
# The first group's figures, shown here from the files just written, so each keeps the
# height it was saved with (a figure size changed partway through a chunk is ignored)
g1 <- meta$group_label[1]
# all lengths, then the ranges drawn in the report (plot_ranges)
for (f in intersect(c("all-lengths", plot_ranges), names(folders))) {
  files <- c(plot_path(plots_dir, "group_density", g1, primary, f, unit = pu[1]), if (is.na(folders[[f]])) plot_path(plots_dir, "group_histogram", g1, primary, f, unit = pu[1]))
  files <- files[file.exists(files)]
  if (!length(files)) next
  # dashes escaped, so pandoc does not turn "---" in a group name into a dash
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s, %s\n\n", gsub("-", "\\\\-", display_group(g1)), if (is.na(folders[[f]])) "all lengths" else folders[[f]]))
  for (fl in files) cat(sprintf("![](%s)\n\n", md_path(fl)))
}
timings["By group"] <- proc.time()["elapsed"] - .t
```

```{r by_sample, eval=want_plot("sample_density", params) || want_plot("sample_histogram", params)}
.t <- proc.time()["elapsed"]
invisible(apply_fn(meta$file_stem, function(s) {
  for (f in names(folders)) {
    rg <- folders[[f]]; fd <- folder_data(s, rg)
    if (!nrow(fd$rd)) next
    xl <- folder_xlim(fd$rd$length)
    for (u in pu) {
      v <- unit_version(fd$rd, fd$md, u)
      if (is.null(v$rd) || !nrow(v$rd)) next
      # the short sample label: the full file name does not fit the width of these figures
      ttl <- sprintf("%s: %s%s, %s", short_labels(meta$file_stem)[[s]], primary, if (is.na(rg)) ", all lengths" else paste0(", ", rg), unit_title[[u]])
      if (want_plot("sample_density", params))
        save_plot(ridge_dots_plot(v$rd, v$md, ttl, paste(primary, "length (repeat units)"), xl, params$plot_dots_max, main_unit = v$main, dots_unit = if (identical(params$plot_dots_unit, "reads")) "Reads" else "Molecules"),
                  plot_path(plots_dir, "sample_density", s, primary, f, unit = u), 10, 3)
      d <- rbind(v$rd[, .(length, unit = v$main)], if (!is.null(v$md)) v$md[, .(length, unit = "Molecules")])
      if (want_plot("sample_histogram", params))
        save_plot(dist_rows(d, ttl, paste(primary, "length (repeat units)"), params$repeat_histogram_binwidth, xlim = xl),
                  plot_path(plots_dir, "sample_histogram", s, primary, f, unit = u), 10, if (is.null(v$md)) 3.5 else 5.5)
    }
  }
  TRUE
}))
timings["By sample"] <- proc.time()["elapsed"] - .t
cat(sprintf("Per-sample density and histogram figures written for %d samples into plots/sample_density/ and plots/sample_histogram/ (a subfolder per unit, then per range).\n", nrow(meta)))
```

# Every range, sample by sample

`r if (have_m6) sprintf("For each sample, the %s length in every analysis range (%d ranges, each in its own panel), after all lengths%s. Each panel is the share of the sample's reads (or molecules) at each length in that range, with a smoothed line, and the range's modal (red), median (purple) and mean (orange) from Module 6 as dashed lines, with their values and the count in the panel's header. This is where to look at any range in any sample; the sample cards below show every measure but only the ranges drawn in the report (%s). One sample is shown here.", primary, length(unique(range_table$range_name[range_table$measure == primary])), if (is.null(mol)) " (reads only: no UMIs in this run)" else sprintf(", one figure per version in plot_units (%s): combined has the reads and the molecules in separate rows of each panel", paste(pu, collapse = ", ")), paste(plot_ranges, collapse = ", ")) else "Module 6 has not been run, so there are no ranges."`

- `07_repeat_lengths/plots/sample_ranges/{unit}/sample_ranges_{sample}_{measure}_{unit}.png`, unit `combined`, `reads` or `molecules`

```{r sample_ranges, eval=have_m6 && want_plot("sample_ranges", params), results='asis'}
.t <- proc.time()["elapsed"]
all_rg <- sort(unique(range_table$range_name[range_table$measure == primary]))
sr_dir <- file.path(plots_dir, "sample_ranges")
make_range_grid <- function(s, u) {
  us <- unit_members(u)
  tabs <- list(reads = rl_s[[s]], molecules = ml_s[[s]])[us]
  if (!any(vapply(tabs, function(t) !is.null(t) && nrow(t) > 0, logical(1)))) return(NULL)
  ulab <- c(reads = "Reads", molecules = "Molecules")
  panels <- list()
  for (rg in c(NA, all_rg)) {
    rr <- if (is.na(rg)) NULL else range_row(s, primary, rg)
    if (!is.na(rg) && is.null(rr)) next
    d <- rbindlist(lapply(us, function(x) if (!is.null(tabs[[x]])) data.table(length = range_vals(tabs[[x]], if (x == "reads") "qname" else "molecule_id", primary, rr), unit = ulab[[x]])))
    d <- d[is.finite(length)]
    if (!nrow(d)) next
    mk <- NULL
    if (!is.na(rg) && !is.null(dist)) {
      mk <- dist[file_stem == s & measure == primary & analysis_range_name == rg & unit %in% us, .(unit = ulab[unit], modal = modal_length, median = median_length, mean = mean_length)]
      mk <- if (nrow(mk)) melt(mk, id.vars = "unit", variable.name = "stat") else NULL
    }
    ttl <- if (is.na(rg)) "All lengths" else sprintf("%s (%s)", rg, sub(paste0("^", primary, " "), "", rr$range_text %||% rr$range_label))
    panels[[length(panels) + 1]] <- dist_rows(d, ttl, paste(primary, "length"), params$repeat_histogram_binwidth, marks = mk) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10), strip.text = element_text(size = 7))
  }
  if (!length(panels)) return(NULL)
  g <- meta[file_stem == s, group_label]; tm <- meta[file_stem == s, time]
  fn <- if (!is.null(funnel)) funnel[file_stem == s][1] else NULL
  acc <- if (!is.null(fn) && nrow(fn)) sprintf("\nReads: %s input, %s spanning both flanks, %s analysed%s", comma(fn$input), comma(fn$both_flanks), comma(fn$final),
                                               if (!is.null(ml_s[[s]])) sprintf("; %s molecules", comma(uniqueN(ml_s[[s]]$molecule_id))) else "") else ""
  nc <- min(4, length(panels))
  list(plot = patchwork::wrap_plots(panels, ncol = nc) +
         patchwork::plot_annotation(title = sprintf("%s: %s, %s", s, primary, unit_title[[u]]),
                                    subtitle = paste0(display_group(g), if (!is.na(tm)) paste0(", time ", tm) else "", "; all lengths, then every analysis range", acc),
                                    caption = stat_key),
       w = 4.2 * nc, h = 1.2 + (if (length(tabs) > 1) 4.4 else 2.6) * ceiling(length(panels) / nc))
}
invisible(apply_fn(meta$file_stem, function(s) {
  for (u in pu) { g <- make_range_grid(s, u); if (!is.null(g)) save_plot(g$plot, plot_path(plots_dir, "sample_ranges", s, primary, unit = u), g$w, g$h) }
  TRUE
}))
f1 <- plot_path(plots_dir, "sample_ranges", meta$file_stem[1], primary, unit = pu[1])
if (file.exists(f1)) cat(sprintf("\n\n![](%s)\n\n", md_path(f1)))
timings["Every range by sample"] <- proc.time()["elapsed"] - .t
```

# Sample cards

One figure per sample, for every measure: the first column is all lengths, the next the reads in each range drawn (`r paste(plot_ranges, collapse = ", ")`). Reads (grey)`r if (!is.null(mol)) " and molecules (teal) are in separate rows, each on its own scale" else " are"` drawn as the share at each length (bars) with a smoothed line (kernel density, bandwidth 1 unit, or 0.5 for a short tract) over them. In the range columns, each row carries its own modal (red), median (purple) and mean (orange) from Module 6 as dashed lines, with their values in the row's header`r if (!is.null(mol)) ", so the read and molecule statistics are each beside their own data" else ""`. The subtitle gives the sample's read accounting. One card from each of up to four groups is shown here for `r primary` only, so it is large enough to read; the cards in `plots/sample_card/{unit}/` (`sample_card_{sample}_{unit}.png`, one per version in plot_units) have every measure.

```{r sample_cards, eval=want_plot("sample_card", params), results='asis', fig.width=13.5}
.t <- proc.time()["elapsed"]
show_s <- meta[, .SD[1], by = group_label][1:min(.N, 4), file_stem]
make_card <- function(s, ms = measures$measure, u = "combined") {
  us <- unit_members(u)
  panels <- list()
  for (m in ms) {
    cols <- c(list(NULL), lapply(plot_ranges, function(rg) range_row(s, m, rg)))
    for (k in seq_along(cols)) {
      rr <- cols[[k]]
      if (k > 1 && is.null(rr)) next
      d <- rbind(if ("reads" %in% us) data.table(length = range_vals(rl_s[[s]], "qname", m, rr), unit = "Reads"),
                 if ("molecules" %in% us && !is.null(ml_s[[s]])) data.table(length = range_vals(ml_s[[s]], "molecule_id", m, rr), unit = "Molecules"))
      if (is.null(d)) next
      d <- d[is.finite(length)]
      if (!nrow(d)) next
      mk <- NULL
      if (k > 1 && !is.null(dist)) {
        mk <- dist[file_stem == s & measure == m & analysis_range_name == rr$range_name & unit %in% us, .(unit = ifelse(unit == "reads", "Reads", "Molecules"),
                                                                                         modal = modal_length, median = median_length, mean = mean_length)]
        mk <- if (nrow(mk)) melt(mk, id.vars = "unit", variable.name = "stat") else NULL
      }
      ttl <- if (k == 1) paste0(m, ": all lengths") else sprintf("%s: %s (%s)", m, rr$range_name, rr$range_text %||% rr$range_label)
      panels[[length(panels) + 1]] <- dist_rows(d, ttl, paste(m, "length"), params$repeat_histogram_binwidth, marks = mk) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
    }
  }
  if (!length(panels)) return(NULL)
  fn <- if (!is.null(funnel)) funnel[file_stem == s][1] else NULL
  sub <- if (!is.null(fn) && nrow(fn)) sprintf("Reads: %s input, %s spanning both flanks, %s analysed%s", comma(fn$input), comma(fn$both_flanks), comma(fn$final),
                                               if (!is.null(ml_s[[s]])) sprintf("; %s molecules", comma(uniqueN(ml_s[[s]]$molecule_id))) else "") else NULL
  g <- meta[file_stem == s, group_label]; tm <- meta[file_stem == s, time]
  patchwork::wrap_plots(panels, ncol = 1 + length(plot_ranges)) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(title = sprintf("%s: %s", s, unit_title[[u]]), subtitle = paste0(display_group(g), if (!is.na(tm)) paste0(", time ", tm) else "", if (!is.null(sub)) paste0("\n", sub) else ""),
                               caption = stat_key)
}
row_h_of <- function(u) if (length(unit_members(u)) > 1) 5 else 3.2
card_w <- 5.5 * (1 + length(plot_ranges))
invisible(apply_fn(meta$file_stem, function(s) {
  for (u in pu) {
    card <- make_card(s, u = u)
    if (!is.null(card)) save_plot(card, plot_path(plots_dir, "sample_card", s, unit = u), card_w, 1.6 + nrow(measures) * row_h_of(u))
  }
  TRUE
}))
row_h <- row_h_of(pu[1])
# The report shows each example card for the primary measure only, so it is large enough to read;
# the saved cards hold every measure
for (s in show_s) {
  card <- make_card(s, primary, pu[1])
  if (is.null(card)) next
  fl <- tempfile(fileext = ".png"); save_plot(card, fl, card_w, 1.6 + row_h)
  cat(sprintf("\n\n![](%s)\n\n", md_path(fl)))
}
timings["Sample cards"] <- proc.time()["elapsed"] - .t
```
